QuestInfo.name: [Sizzling Santa] Reindeer Roundup 1-2
QuestInfo.0: Ask Lou about finding some reindeer.
QuestInfo.1: Merry the reindeer doesn't like people and is quite happy to stay in the Monster Park.\r\n#bGet some sweet fruit from monsters in the Monster Park to tempt Merry.#k
QuestInfo.2: You got Merry the reindeer to join you.

item.0: We might need to lure them out with some food.\r\nIf they like living here, they must like the food. Beat up some of the monsters and take their fruit.
